lines.en: label iodorm35:
scene iovisityuki1
I decide to spend the night with Io in hopes that, this time, I’ll be able to make it at least an hour or two in without making her uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 我决定今晚陪 Io 一起过夜，希望这一次，我至少能撑上一两个小时而不让她感到不舒服。

lines.en: It should be a little easier now that she’s outright told me about her aversion to [[the good kind of] physical contact, but that doesn’t mean I won’t figure out a way to ruin things regardless.
lines.zh: 既然她已经直截了当地告诉我，她有多反感「那种好的」肢体接触，按理说应该会稍微轻松一些——但这并不代表我就没办法把事情搞砸。

lines.en: Because, to be fair, she’s dropped plenty of hints about this exact thing so far and it has changed literally nothing about my actions- but that ends today.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，到目前为止她就这件事已经暗示过无数次了，而我的行为没有一丝一毫的改变——不过今天就到此为止。

lines.en: Or rather, it ended last time we talked. But also today.
lines.zh: 或者说，上次我们谈过之后就已经结束了。不过今天也算。

lines.en: Anyway, here comes Io.
lines.zh: 总之，Io 来了。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki2
: Greetings, Master! Party of one? Our specials today are smiles and love. And also the new deluxe strawberry parfait Osako-chan just came up with for the low, low cost of 2,000 yen.
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临，主人！一位吗？我们今天的招牌菜是微笑与爱。此外还有 Osako 酱刚研发出来的新品豪华草莓芭菲，只要低到离谱的 2000 日元。

lines.en: : Has the cafe somehow gone bankrupt and been relocated to your dorm room?
lines.zh: : 咖啡厅是破产了然后搬进你们寝室了吗？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki3
: As if we’d ever go bankrupt with how much time you spend there, Master. You’re basically subsidizing Uta-chan’s entire livelihood at this point.
lines.zh: : 有您在那里花那么多时间，我们怎么可能破产呢。您现在基本上就是在资助 Uta 酱的整个生计了。

lines.en: : Well, if the cafe isn’t here, why are you in Uta-chan mode?
lines.zh: : 好吧，既然咖啡厅不在这儿，你为什么是 Uta 酱模式？

lines.en: : Beats me. I don’t always get to choose when I switch back and forth. What brings you over, though? Which one of us are you lookin’ for, you sly dog you?
lines.zh: : 鬼知道。我又不是每次都能自己选择在两种状态之间切来切去。不过你来这儿干嘛？你是来找我们哪个人的，你这滑头。

lines.en: : Io.
lines.zh: : Io。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki4
: Man, you couldn’t even lie to me?
lines.zh: : 拜托，你连骗我一下都不肯？

lines.en: : Sorry, there’s just something I wanted to talk to her about that I probably shouldn’t involve you in at this point in time.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，只是有件事我想跟她谈谈，现阶段大概不适合把你卷进来。

lines.en: : Well, what the heck is it? We don’t keep secrets in this household. Out with it, Master.
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么事啊？我们这家可不藏秘密。从实招来，主人。

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just that quirky character trait of hers where she wants me to have sex with her best friend so we can all live happily ever after.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就是她那个古怪的性格特质——想让我和她最好的朋友上床，好让我们三个从此幸福地生活在一起。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki5
: She actually told you about that?!
lines.zh: : 她真的把这事跟你说了？！

lines.en: if day <= 5:
: Also, what the heck do you think you’re sayin’ in the middle of the hallway on a weekday?! Someone could hear you!
lines.zh: : 还有，你他妈以为自己在工作日的走廊中间说些什么呢？！别人会听见的！

lines.en: : I take it you were just as surprised to hear about this as I was?
lines.zh: : 看来你听到这事的时候和我一样惊讶？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki6
: Oh! Not at all, Sensei! I thought it was totally friggin’ normal that girl-hating Io was randomly cool with the idea of a throuple! I wasn’t surprised at all!
lines.zh: : 哦！完全没有，Sensei！我觉得讨厌女生的 Io 突然对三人行这种想法这么无所谓，简直他妈的太正常了！我可一点都不惊讶！

lines.en: scene iovisityuki7
: That set your sarcasm detector off? Cause it should’ve.
lines.zh: : 那句话触发你的讽刺探测器了？因为它本来就该响。

lines.en: : I have no idea what that girl’s been on lately. But whatever it is, her dosage needs to get halved cause this whole throuple thing is just crazy talk. The heck does she think she’s proposing?
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道那丫头最近在嗑什么药。但不管是什么，她的剂量都该减半，因为这个三人行的事纯粹是疯话。她到底以为自己在提什么建议？

lines.en: : I take it you’re not a fan of the idea, then?
lines.zh: : 看来你不太赞成这个主意？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki8
: Course I’m not a fan of the idea.
lines.zh: : 我当然不赞成。

lines.en: : I get where it’s coming from, but...I don’t know. What she wants just seems all sorts of wrong to me. There’s no way something like that could work out without one of us getting hurt.
lines.zh: : 我理解她为什么会这么想，但是……我不知道。她想要的东西在我看来就是哪儿哪儿都不对。这种事不可能在没人受伤的情况下成真。

lines.en: : Gotcha. So it’s not the having sex with me part you’re not cool with, it’s the Io part.
lines.zh: : 懂了。所以你介意的不是「和我上床」这部分，而是「Io」这部分。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki9
: Huh? What? Huh? Me? You? Huh?
lines.zh: : 哈？什么？哈？我？你？哈？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki10
: A-Anyway! Io was going over to Yuki’s place tonight and...I’ve got lots of homework to do, so...it’d probably be best if you just...you know...didn’t come inside.
lines.zh: : 总、总之！Io 今晚去 Yuki 家了，而且……我有一大堆作业要做，所以……你最好还是……你知道的……别进来。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki9
: The room! Didn’t come inside {i}the room!{/i} Not...Not Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 房间！是别进{i}房间{/i}！不是……不是 Uta 酱。

lines.en: : I knew what you meant, Uta.
lines.zh: : 我知道你什么意思，Uta。

lines.en: : Uta-{i}chan.{/i} Regular Uta’s not home. Cause she’d {i}definitely{/i} never say any of this weird stuff that the customer service oriented version is saying.
lines.zh: : Uta {i}酱{/i}。平常的 Uta 不在家。因为客服模式版说的这些怪话，真正的她{i}绝对{/i}说不出口。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki11
: Anyway! Have a nice day! Or night! And don’t come anywhere you’re not supposed to! Bye!
lines.zh: : 总之！祝你愉快！白天也好晚上也好！还有，别去任何你不该去的地方！再见！

lines.en: scene iovisityuki1
: {i}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}WHY DID I SAY THAT?!?!?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我为什么会说那种话？！？！？！{/i}

lines.en: : You know I can still hear you in there, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我在里面还是听得见你说话的吧？

lines.en: : No you can’t! Go away!
lines.zh: : 听不见！你走开！

lines.en: scene black
With nothing else to do and Io nowhere to be found, I decide to head home for the night.
lines.zh: 无事可做，Io 又不见踪影，我决定今晚就先回家。

lines.en: But only after embarrassing the one resident of Dorm 7 that I {i}don’t{/i} have to be careful with.
lines.zh: 不过得先把七号宿舍里那个我唯一{i}无需{/i}小心翼翼对待的住户捉弄一番再说。

lines.en: It’s definitely strange hearing that {i}Uta{/i} is the one who has issues with Io’s “arrangement,” though.
lines.zh: 不过听说对 Io 那套「安排」有意见的人居然是 {i}Uta{/i}，这感觉确实挺奇怪的。

lines.en: If you’d have asked me several months ago, I would have assumed it to be the other way around.
lines.zh: 要是几个月前你问我，我肯定会以为是反过来的。

lines.en: And while it’s true that both of them have rejected my advances, it seems like only one of them is forcing themselves to.
lines.zh: 虽然她们两个确实都拒绝过我的追求，但看起来只有其中一个是在勉强自己。

lines.en: The other is just defective.
lines.zh: 另一个则纯粹是有缺陷。

lines.en: {i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene iovisityuki12
: I didn’t overdo it, did I?
lines.zh: : 我没买太多吧？

lines.en: : No. No way. I mean, this is Yuki we’re talking about. I highly doubt she’s actually cooking herself balanced meals every night.
lines.zh: : 没有。绝对没有。毕竟对方是 Yuki。我很怀疑她真的每天晚上都在给自己做营养均衡的饭菜。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki13
: But, then again, this is weird. I’m being weird. She didn’t even invite me over and now I have enough groceries to fill her fridge.
lines.zh: : 可是，话说回来，这也太奇怪了。我这样很奇怪。她根本没邀请我过去，可我却拎了足够塞满她冰箱的一堆东西。

lines.en: : Wait...does she even have a fridge? Should I just try and return all of this stuff? Does the grocery store even accept returns?
lines.zh: : 等等……她到底有没有冰箱？要不我把这些东西全退回去？便利店到底接不接受退货？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki14
: Damn it, Io. Can you do anything right at all? You’re just going to make Yuki think you’re awkward and-
lines.zh: : 靠，Io。你到底有哪件事能做得对？你只会让 Yuki 觉得你很别扭，然后——

lines.en: : But...wait. You {i}are{/i} awkward. So why is having someone {i}think{/i} you’re awkward bad when allowing them to think {i}otherwise{/i} would only screw up their expectations and-
lines.zh: : 可是……等等。你{i}本来{/i}就别扭。那为什么让别人{i}觉得{/i}你别扭是坏事呢，明明让他们以为你{i}不别扭{/i}，只会把他们的期待搞砸，然后——

lines.en: : You know what? Maybe I’ll just go home. I can always try again next week. And I’m kind of tired anyway, so-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我还是回家吧。反正下周还能再试一次。而且我也挺累的，所以——

lines.en: : Hm?
scene iovisityuki15
: Hm?
scene nightsky
: You look kinda familiar...
lines.zh: : 你看起来有点眼熟……

lines.en: : I’m not. You probably have me confused with someone else.
lines.zh: : 我不眼熟。你大概是认错人了。

lines.en: : I’ll be on my way n-
lines.zh: : 我先走了，我——

lines.en: : Nah, hold up a sec.
lines.zh: : 别，等一下。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki16
: Ain’t we in the same class or whatever?
lines.zh: : 我们是不是同班的来着？

lines.en: : No. I’ll be leaving now.
lines.zh: : 不是。我现在就要走了。

lines.en: : The fuck you lyin’ to me for? You’re, uhh...Ito, right? Or was it...Iro?
lines.zh: : 你他妈骗我干嘛？你是，呃……Ito，对吧？还是说……Iro？

lines.en: : Iori?
lines.zh: : Iori？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki17
: You know what? Come to think of it, we {i}are{/i} in the same class. I just don’t normally see you in there.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？仔细想想，我们{i}确实{/i}是同班的。只是我平时在教室里见不到你。

lines.en: : And it’s {i}Io,{/i} by the way. We had an entire contest thing against each other...Ring any bells?
lines.zh: : 顺便一提，我叫 {i}Io{/i}。我们还搞过一整个什么比赛来着……想起来了吗？

lines.en: : Not really. The fuck you doin’ over {i}here{/i} for, though? You live in this dump or some shit?
lines.zh: : 不太记得。不过你他妈跑{i}这儿{/i}来干嘛？你住在这破地方还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki18
: I was visiting someone. Or...{i}trying{/i} to at least.
lines.zh: : 我是来拜访某人的。或者说……至少是{i}想{/i}拜访。

lines.en: : Friend of yours? Boyfriend? Family?
lines.zh: : 你朋友？男朋友？家人？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki19
: Do you forcefully interrogate {i}everyone{/i} you meet for the first time? Or...?
lines.zh: : 你对{i}每个{/i}初次见面的人都要这么强行审问一番吗？还是说……？

lines.en: : Oh, no. My bad. I just...ain’t really used to strikin’ up conversations and shit.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是。我的错。我只是……不太习惯主动跟人搭话什么的。

lines.en: : Then why strike one up with {i}me?{/i} I probably hate people even more than you do.
lines.zh: : 那你干嘛偏要跟{i}我{/i}搭话？我大概比你还要讨厌人。

lines.en: : Just...seemed like you were havin’ a shitty night. That’s all. I’ll leave you alone if you want.
lines.zh: : 只是……看起来你今晚过得挺糟的。就这样。你要是还想一个人待着，我也不拦你。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki20
: Ugh...fuck my life.
lines.zh: : 唉……我这操蛋的人生。

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be harder to talk to or something? Why do you seem so...weirdly rational?
lines.zh: : 你不是应该更难相处才对吗？为什么你看起来……理性得有点诡异？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki21
: Beats the fuck outta me. I ain’t really known for my {i}rationality{/i} after all. But it ain’t like I’m just gonna go around startin’ problems with people for no reason whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 操，我他妈怎么知道。反正我也不是以{i}理性{/i}出名的。但我也不是那种会无缘无故到处找茬的人。

lines.en: : The old me might’a done that shit, but I ain’t really like that anymore. I’ve like...{i}grown{/i} or something. Whatever the fuck they call it.
lines.zh: : 以前的我说不定会干那种破事，但我已经不是那样了。算是……{i}成长{/i}了吧。管他们管这叫什么来着。

lines.en: : Do you...want me to {i}congratulate{/i} you? Because that's not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 你……想要我{i}恭喜{/i}你吗？因为那是不可能的。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki22
: Not really. But if you wanna come inside and chill for a little while, you can.
lines.zh: : 不怎么想。不过你要是愿意进来坐一会儿，也行。

lines.en: : Ain’t my apartment, but I’ve got a key and shit. And it’ll give you a chance to rest or whatever before you finish chickening out on bringing all that shit to...wherever the fuck you were tryin’ to bring it.
lines.zh: : 这不是我的公寓，但我有钥匙什么的。而且你还能趁机歇口气，然后再继续怂着不敢把那堆东西送到……管你他妈本来想送到哪儿去。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Yeah, I’m probably just gonna finish chickening out instead. I’ve seen what you can do to people and I’d prefer to not have my teeth punched in, thanks.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我大概还是会继续怂下去。我见过你对别人下手的场面，我可不想被揍掉牙，谢了。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki23
: I ain’t gonna lay a finger on you, don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我不会碰你一根指头的，别担心。

lines.en: : Learned my lesson last time. Hit the wrong person at the wrong time {i}once{/i} and it’s like throwin’ away everything you’ve worked for.
lines.zh: : 上次已经吸取教训了。在错误的时间打了错误的人{i}一次{/i}，就等于把你辛苦攒下的一切都扔了。

lines.en: : And it ain’t like I have shit to begin with now that I’m startin’ over again, but...still. I ain’t gonna touch you.
lines.zh: : 而且现在我重新开始，本来就已经一无所有了，不过……总之。我不会动你。

lines.en: : Don’t fuck with me and I won’t fuck with you. That’s my new policy. Do with that whatever the fuck you will. Doesn’t make a difference to me.
lines.zh: : 你不招惹我，我就不招惹你。这是我的新原则。你想怎么理解都行。对我来说无所谓。

lines.en: scene black
: Ugh...fine. Okay.
lines.zh: : 唉……行吧。好吧。

lines.en: : But...just for a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 不过……就待几分钟。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki24
: Well...here we are. Welcome to Casa Del Shithole.
lines.zh: : 那么……到了。欢迎光临「屎坑之家」。

lines.en: : Wow...Yuki’s place is actually a lot nicer than I thought it would be.
lines.zh: : 哇……Yuki 家比我想象的要好不少。

lines.en: : Yeah. She ain’t-
lines.zh: : 是啊。她不——

lines.en: scene iovisityuki25
: Wait, what’d you just say?
lines.zh: : 等等，你刚刚说什么？

lines.en: : Oh! Uhh...that...{i}your{/i} place is a lot nicer than I thought it would be.
lines.zh: : 哦！呃……我是说……{i}你家{/i}比我想象的要好不少。

lines.en: : Really? Cause I could’a sworn you-
lines.zh: : 真的吗？因为我明明记得你——

lines.en: : I think I know what {i}I{/i} said, thanks.
lines.zh: : {i}我自己{/i}说了什么我还是知道的，谢谢。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki26
: R...Right. Well, as I was sayin’ before, this ain’t my place. I just come here to eat food and crash on the couch whenever I’m in the area.
lines.zh: : 对、对。总之，就像我刚才说的，这不是我的地方。我只是路过这边的时候来蹭点吃的、在沙发上凑合一晚。

lines.en: : And I’ve been, like...lookin’ for jobs and shit around here, so I’ve been around a lot lately.
lines.zh: : 而且我最近一直在这一带……找工作什么的，所以来得挺勤。

lines.en: : Figured it’d be easy findin’ somethin’ over here since it’s, like...what do you call it...a low-income area or something? I don’t know. This is where the poor people chill, basically. So I’m right at home.
lines.zh: : 想着这边应该好找活儿干，毕竟这里算是……怎么说来着……低收入区还是什么的？我也不知道。基本上就是穷人们待的地儿，所以我在这儿如鱼得水。

lines.en: : It’s not that bad. I kind of like it.
lines.zh: : 也没那么糟。我还挺喜欢的。

lines.en: : Yeah, you ain’t had to deal with the sirens and trains and shit in the middle of the night yet. Or the busted ass AC or how the windows get stuck when you try and open ‘em to get rid of all the smoke.
lines.zh: : 那是你还没体验过大半夜的警笛声和火车声什么的。还有那台破空调，以及你想开窗散味时那些卡死的窗户。

lines.en: : I guess not...
lines.zh: : 大概吧……

lines.en: scene iovisityuki27
: Is there a fridge I can put all this stuff in? I don’t want it getting cold.
lines.zh: : 有冰箱可以让我把这些东西放进去吗？我可不想让它们变凉。

lines.en: : Then why the fuck would you put it in the fridge?
lines.zh: : 那你他妈干嘛要放进冰箱？

lines.en: : That’s-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: : Wait, hold on. No. I meant I...don’t want it getting cold...naturally?
lines.zh: : 等等，不对。我是说……我不想让它们……自己变凉？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Can you just tell me where the fucking fridge is?
lines.zh: : 你能不能直接告诉我他妈的冰箱在哪儿？

lines.en: : Behind me and to the left. Mind grabbin’ me a water while you’re in there?
lines.zh: : 在我身后，靠左。进去的时候顺便帮我拿瓶水呗？

lines.en: scene black
: Are you incapable of getting one yourself? What about the nine thousand half-empty water bottles lying around the room? Will one of them work?
lines.zh: : 你自己连拿一瓶都做不到吗？房间里那九千个喝了一半的水瓶呢？随便挑一个不行吗？

lines.en: : Ew, no. I can’t remember which ones are mine and I’ll be damned if I accidentally trade spit with some bitch who’s probably got every disease known to man.
lines.zh: : 恶，不要。我记不清哪些是我的了，我要是不小心跟某个八成把人类所有病都得了一遍的贱人交换了口水，那我可真是日了狗了。

lines.en: : Boo-hoo. Woe is you.
lines.zh: : 呜呜呜。你真可怜啊。

lines.en: : The fuck’s your deal? Just get me a damn water. You can take one too if you want.
lines.zh: : 你他妈怎么回事？给我拿瓶该死的水就行了。你想拿一瓶也可以。

lines.en: : I just think you should be a little less generous when it comes to giving away {i}someone else’s{/i} stuff when none of this is yours to hand out in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，你在拿{i}别人{/i}的东西做人情的时候应该稍微收敛一点，毕竟这里没一样东西是你的，你本来就无权支配。

lines.en: : And I think you should dye your hair a normal fuckin’ color but you don’t see me preachin’ that with every single step you take.
lines.zh: : 我还觉得你该把头发染成正常点的颜色呢，你也没见我在你每走一步的时候都念叨这个啊。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki28
: Touche. Also, whoops. Forgot your water.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。还有，哎呀。忘了给你拿水了。

lines.en: : You didn’t forget shit, you little brat. You did that on purpose.
lines.zh: : 你才没忘呢，你这个小混蛋。你是故意的。

lines.en: : If you want water, you can buy your own or use the faucet. Someone worked for what’s in that fridge and it’s not fair if someone else just takes it.
lines.zh: : 你想喝水，可以自己去买，或者用自来水。冰箱里的东西是有人花钱买的，别人随便拿走就不公平。

lines.en: : Use the faucet? In a place like this? Would be safer to drink my own piss. ‘Sides, the bitch who lives here owes me. She can go without a bottle or two.
lines.zh: : 用自来水？在这种地方？喝我自己的尿还更安全点。再说了，住在这儿的贱人欠我的。她少一两瓶水也无所谓。

lines.en: : Owes you for what exactly?
lines.zh: : 她到底欠你什么？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki29
: Oh, not much. Only scarring me for life and shit like that. You know how it is.
lines.zh: : 哦，没什么。不过就是给我留下一辈子的心理阴影之类的。你懂的。

lines.en: : Or maybe you don’t. Ain’t got a clue what your fuckin’ background is- just that it probably ain’t hard to connect the dots in figurin’ out where you and me are on the {i}social ladder{/i} based on context clues.
lines.zh: : 也许你不懂。我他妈对你的背景一无所知——只是根据蛛丝马迹，大概不难推断出你和我各自处在{i}社会阶梯{/i}的哪一级。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki30
: Yeah...I guess you're right about that.
lines.zh: : 是啊……你说得对。

lines.en: : So what’s {i}your{/i} deal? Where’s that “fuck the world” attitude come from? Shit like that doesn’t just happen on its own. Know that from experience.
lines.zh: : 那么{i}你{/i}到底怎么回事？那副「去他妈的世界」的态度是从哪儿来的？这种事不会凭空发生。我有经验，所以知道。

lines.en: : I’d prefer not talking about myself with people I don’t know very well.
lines.zh: : 我不太想跟不太熟的人聊自己的事。

lines.en: : Shit like that is what makes it impossible to get to know somebody in the first place, but...
lines.zh: : 正是这种态度才让一开始就没法跟人熟起来，不过……

lines.en: : Fair enough. Just trying to make shit less quiet. And it seems like the only things we’ve got in common are bein’ stuck in here and the fact that we’ve got the same douchebag teacher.
lines.zh: : 行吧。我只是想让气氛别那么安静。而且看起来我们唯一的共同点就是被困在这儿，还有拥有同一个混蛋老师。

lines.en: : Sensei’s not a douchebag. He’s a good person.
lines.zh: : Sensei 不是混蛋。他是个好人。

lines.en: : Sure, if your idea of being a good person is hooking up with children and getting paid to neglect your responsibilities all day long.
lines.zh: : 当然，如果你对「好人」的定义是跟学生上床，还有拿着工资整天玩忽职守的话。

lines.en: : No one’s perfect. We’re probably just as fucked up as he is when it really comes down to it.
lines.zh: : 没有人是完美的。说到底，我们大概跟他一样烂。

lines.en: : But we’re also teenagers. We ain’t supposed to be {i}perfect.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但我们也是青少年啊。我们本来就不该{i}完美{/i}。

lines.en: : This is the age where we’re supposed to be fuckin’ around and findin’ shit out as we go. That dude’s fuckin’ doubled our lives and he still hasn’t gotten that shit down yet.
lines.zh: : 这个年纪本来就该一边闯祸一边摸索着长大。那家伙年纪是我们的两倍了，却还没搞懂这些破事。

lines.en: : So what? Neither has your mom apparently and you’re still coming here to mooch off of her. Some people take longer to fully develop than others.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？你妈显然也没搞懂，你不是照样跑来这儿蹭她。有些人就是比别人成熟得慢。

lines.en: : And some people never fully develop at all.
lines.zh: : 而有些人根本一辈子都长不大。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki31

: From one fuck-up to another, you ever worry that you’ll end up like that? That school will end before you’ve ever figured out a direction you’re supposed to head in and that it’ll all just...burn to the ground after that?
lines.zh: : 从一个废物到另一个废物，你有没有担心过自己会变成那样？担心学校生涯会在你还没找到该往哪个方向走之前就结束，然后一切就这么……付之一炬？

lines.en: : Think? No. I’ve already accepted that fate.
lines.zh: : 担心？不。我已经接受了这个命运。

lines.en: : Why? We’re young as shit. Feelin’ sorry for ourselves is only gonna wind up hurting the people we care about further down the line.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我们还年轻得要命。自怨自艾到头来只会伤害我们在乎的人。

lines.en: : You say that as if I have anyone I actually care about.
lines.zh: : 你这话说得好像我真有在乎的人似的。

lines.en: : Don’t you?
lines.zh: : 没有吗？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki32
: You’re close with that loudmouth girl, ain’t ya? The short one who sucks at arm wrestling.
lines.zh: : 你跟那个大嗓门的女生关系挺好的吧？就是那个掰手腕很烂的小个子。

lines.en: : Uta? Yeah. She’s the only girl I actually like.
lines.zh: : Uta？是啊。她是我唯一真正喜欢的女生。

lines.en: : Then wouldn’t you feel like shit letting her down and not doin’ anything with your life?
lines.zh: : 那你不会因为让她失望、一辈子一事无成而觉得难受吗？

lines.en: : Not really. She knows better than to expect anything out of me. And I doubt I’ll wind up even making it to 30 in the first place.
lines.zh: : 不会。她很清楚不该对我抱什么期待。而且我怀疑自己能不能活到 30 岁都还是个问题。

lines.en: : What? You ain’t, like...thinkin’ of killin’ yourself or some shit, are you? Cause if I just accidentally prevented a suicide, that’s pretty fuckin-
lines.zh: : 什么？你该不会……是在想自杀什么的吧？要是我刚不小心阻止了一场自杀，那可真是太他妈的——

lines.en: : I’m not going to do something like that. I’m way too afraid of not knowing what comes next.
lines.zh: : 我不会做那种事。我只是太害怕不知道接下来会发生什么了。

lines.en: : It’s just a feeling I have, really. There’s no rhyme or reason to it.
lines.zh: : 真的只是一种感觉罢了。说不出什么道理。

lines.en: : Huh...
scene iovisityuki33
: Well, that’s fuckin’ dumb.
lines.zh: : 啊，那可真是蠢透了。

lines.en: : I never said it wasn’t. All I said was that it’s a feeling I have. And with that in mind, it’s no different from wasting your time worrying whether or not you’ll wind up as someone’s definition of a failure.
lines.zh: : 我又没说不是。我只说了那是我拥有的一种感觉。既然如此，它就和你浪费时间去担心自己会不会变成别人口中的失败者没什么区别。

lines.en: : How so?
lines.zh: : 怎么说？

lines.en: : Well...life is just a whole bunch of {i}feelings{/i} at the end of the day. Right?
lines.zh: : 嗯……人生说到底不过是一大堆{i}感觉{/i}。对吧？

lines.en: : We get happy when good things happen...or sad when shitty things happen. All we’re really doing is reacting to the world around us doing its...shitty world stuff.
lines.zh: : 发生好事的时候我们会开心……发生烂事的时候会难过。我们真正在做的，不过是对周围这个操蛋的世界正在干的操蛋事情做出反应罢了。

lines.en: : And so, when you start to think about it like that, nothing we do matters in the first place.
lines.zh: : 所以，你要是这么想的话，我们做什么根本就不重要。

lines.en: : Like, yeah, we can work hard and set goals and shit. We can make our {i}dreams come true.{/i} But there’s so much happening {i}around{/i} us that we have no influence over that it makes those goals seem kind of sucky.
lines.zh: : 就好比，是啊，我们可以努力、可以定目标什么的。我们可以{i}实现梦想{/i}。但我们{i}身边{/i}发生着太多我们根本无力左右的事情，这让那些目标显得有点没劲。

lines.en: : I ain’t gettin’ it. How’s that make thinkin’ you’re a failure the same thing as thinkin’ you’re gonna die at an early age?
lines.zh: : 我没听懂。这跟「觉得自己是失败者」和「觉得自己会早死」是同一回事有什么关系？

lines.en: : Well, it’s like...not everybody has the same idea of what it means to...fail, I guess? And they’re both...things you can never really know for sure? Does that make sense?
lines.zh: : 怎么说呢……大概不是每个人对「失败」的定义都一样？而且这两件事……都是你永远没法真正确定的？说得通吗？

lines.en: : Not really. Sounds to me like you’re just talkin’ outta your ass.
lines.zh: : 不怎么通。听起来你就是在瞎扯。

lines.en: scene iovisityuki34
: Ha...maybe you’re right.
lines.zh: : 哈……也许你说得对。

lines.en: : Maybe I {i}am{/i} just talking out of my ass.
lines.zh: : 也许我{i}就是{/i}在瞎扯。

lines.en: : But when you never learn how to properly express yourself, things like...explaining your {i}feelings{/i} or {i}opinions{/i} become a lot like mazes.
lines.zh: : 但是，当你从来没学会怎么好好表达自己，像解释自己的{i}感受{/i}或{i}想法{/i}这种事就会变得很像走迷宫。

lines.en: : And even the people who {i}make{/i} mazes aren’t immune to getting stuck in them. We all need to fail or get lost and shit and...some people can work through that while others just give up.
lines.zh: : 而且就连{i}造{/i}迷宫的人自己也会困在里面。我们都需要失败、需要迷路之类的……有些人能走出来，有些人就直接放弃了。

lines.en: : And you’re one of those “give-up” types, I guess?
lines.zh: : 那你大概就是那种「放弃」型的？

lines.en: scene iovisityuki35
: I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。

lines.en: : Which means you’re the other one?
lines.zh: : 那你就是另一种？

lines.en: : I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。

lines.en: : Ain’t nothin’ to write home about though when I still ain’t done shit.
lines.zh: : 不过我到现在还是他妈一事无成，也没什么好吹的。

lines.en: : Not like I have anyone to write to in the first place.
lines.zh: : 反正我也没有可以写信回家的人。

lines.en: : Same here.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: : Truth is...I’ve only {i}just{/i} started talkin’ to my mom again after all the shit she put me through when I was little.
lines.zh: : 实话说……在我小时候她让我受了那么多苦之后，我{i}才{/i}刚开始重新跟妈妈说话。

lines.en: : ...What?
: It’s like...that whole “never learning how to express yourself” thing you brought up a second ago.
lines.zh: : 就好像……你刚才提到的那个「从来没学会表达自己」的问题。

lines.en: : That was me too. Or...{i}is{/i} me. Which is probably why I also only have, like...one friend.
lines.zh: : 那也是我。或者……现在{i}还是{/i}。所以我大概才只有，嗯……一个朋友。

lines.en: : My mom was a hardcore junkie.
lines.zh: : 我妈是个彻头彻尾的瘾君子。

lines.en: : She walked out on me when I was really little and I had to...pretty much grow up {i}without{/i} parents since my dad was always busy with...{i}work.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我很小的时候她就抛下我走了，而我爸爸又总是忙着……{i}工作{/i}，所以我基本上是在{i}没有{/i}父母的情况下长大的。

lines.en: : Wasn’t easy...but I made it this far without anyone’s help, so I guess that’s somethin’ to be proud of or whatever.
lines.zh: : 不容易……但我一个人也撑到了今天，所以我想这也算是件值得骄傲的事吧。

lines.en: : And, you know...I think I was doin’ pretty okay until she walked back into my life. Like, yeah, I was an asshole and a bully and shit...but I’m still kind of those things {i}now,{/i} so...
lines.zh: : 而且，你知道……我觉得在她重新闯进我的生活之前，我过得还算不错。就是说，是啊，我是个混蛋，是个恶霸什么的……但我{i}现在{/i}也还是那副德行，所以……

lines.en: : I just don’t get how someone can disappear for so long and then just...try to patch things up. Makes my whole struggle growin’ up seem like it was all for nothing.
lines.zh: : 我只是搞不懂，一个人怎么能消失那么久，然后又跑来想把关系修补好。这让我从小到大所有的挣扎都显得像白费了一样。

lines.en: : Like she got to take the easy road while I bashed my head against the fuckin’ wall hopin’ that one day I’d-
lines.zh: : 就好像她走了那条轻松的路，而我却拿头去撞那堵该死的墙，只盼着有一天我能——

lines.en: : Pfft...
lines.zh: : Pfft...

lines.en: scene iovisityuki36
: Pfft!
lines.zh: : Pfft!

lines.en: : Hahah...haha...hahahah!!!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈哈……哈哈哈哈！！！

lines.en: scene iovisityuki37
: Are you...
: Are you...{i}laughing{/i} at me?...
scene iovisityuki38
: {i}That’s{/i} your tragic backstory?
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}就是你的悲惨身世？

lines.en: : Your mom {i}wasn’t there?{/i} And now she {i}is{/i} again?
lines.zh: : 你妈妈{i}不在{/i}？现在{i}又回来了{/i}？

lines.en: : That’s all it took to break you?
lines.zh: : 就这么点事就把你击垮了？

lines.en: : Wha-
: Are you kidding? You are. You have to be. Am I really not supposed to laugh at that?
lines.zh: : 你在开玩笑吧？你肯定是在开玩笑。这种事我难道还不能笑吗？

lines.en: : It’s not funny!
lines.zh: : 这一点都不好笑！

lines.en: : Oh, I know.
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道。

lines.en: : It’s fucking {i}hilarious.{/i}
lines.zh: : 它他妈的{i}滑稽透顶{/i}。

lines.en: : Who...
: Who the fuck do you think you are, talking to me like that?! You ain’t got the faintest idea of the shit that I’ve been through!
lines.zh: : 你他妈以为自己是谁，敢这么跟我说话？！你根本不知道我都经历过些什么！

lines.en: scene iovisityuki39
: I would have {i}killed{/i} for what you’ve {i}been through.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你所{i}经历过的{/i}那些，我愿意{i}拿命去换{/i}。

lines.en: : You...what?...
: Do you know what I got instead?
lines.zh: : 你知道我得到的又是什么吗？

lines.en: : Tell me.
lines.zh: : 告诉我。

lines.en: : {i}Do you know{/i} what I got instead?
lines.zh: : 你{i}知道{/i}我得到的又是什么吗？

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: scene black
: You don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 你不会想知道的。
